```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |> st_make_valid()

# Filter OHI regions to marine polygons
ohi_regions_marine <- ohi_regions |>
  filter(location == "marine")
```

```{r}
# Read in Rodoliths data
rodoliths <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/rodoliths/rodolith_merge.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  st_transform(st_crs(ohi_regions))

# See if CRSs match
print(st_crs(rodoliths) == st_crs(ohi_regions))
```


```{r}
# Make data match extent of the ohi_regions layer
rodoliths <- st_intersection(rodoliths, ohi_regions)
```

```{r}
# Make a template raster to use in rasterization to make sure cell grids line up
template_100m <- rast(
  ext(ohi_regions),
  resolution = 100,   # 100 m res
  crs = st_crs(ohi_regions)$wkt
)
```

```{r}
# Rasterize the vector data
soft_bottom_100m  <- rasterize(vect(rodoliths),  template_100m, field = 1, background = 0)
```

## Quick validation
```{r}
# Check alignment (resolution, origin, extent, CRS, rotation, cell alignment)
compareGeom(soft_bottom_100m, template_100m)
```


```{r}
summary(values(soft_bottom_100m))
```

```{r}
# Groups every 10×10 block of 100‑m cells into one 1‑km cell, and computes the mean of values inside that block
soft_bottom_fraction <- aggregate(soft_bottom_100m, fact = 10, fun = "mean")
```

```{r}
# Checks to see if resolution is 1000m and if values are between 0-1
summary(values(soft_bottom_fraction))
res(soft_bottom_fraction)
```

```{r}
# Mask out raster not in OHI marine regions
marine_mask <- rasterize(
  vect(ohi_regions_marine),
  soft_bottom_fraction,
  field = 1,
  background = NA
)

soft_bottom_fraction_marine <- mask(soft_bottom_fraction, marine_mask)
```



```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(soft_bottom_fraction_marine) +
  tm_raster(
    palette = "-viridis",
    title = "Proportion Soft Bottom",
    alpha = 0.8,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),   # FORCE scale 0 → 1
    legend.format = list(digits = 2)
  ) +
tm_shape(ohi_regions_marine) +
  tm_borders(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
tm_layout(
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    frame = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
rodolith_beds_1km <- soft_bottom_fraction_marine
# NA out rodalith beds
rodolith_beds_1km[rodolith_beds_1km <= 0] <- NA
```


## Destructive fishing data
```{r}
# Years of destructive fishing data available
years <- 2007:2025

# Build full file paths for each year's raster and load them into a multi-layer SpatRaster
fishing_rasters <- rast(
  paste0(
    "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/vessels/benthic_destructive_fishing/destructive_fishing_hours_",
    years,
    "_1km.tif"
  )
)

# Print the total rasters in the stack
nlyr(fishing_rasters)
```

```{r}
soft_bottom_aligned <- project(rodolith_beds_1km, fishing_rasters[[1]])

compareGeom(soft_bottom_aligned, fishing_rasters)
```


```{r}
# Convert fishing hours to area km² of disturbance for each raster cell
disturbance_raster_km2 <- fishing_rasters * 3.704 * 0.030
```

```{r}
max(disturbance_raster_km2[[7]])
```

```{r}
# Cap disturbance at 1 km² since there can't be more than 1 km² disturbance in a 1km² cell
disturbance_raster_km2[disturbance_raster_km2 > 1] <- 1
```


```{r}
# Find the km² of trawl disturbance per km² of soft‑bottom habitat present in the pixel. 
disturbance_km_per_km_soft_bottom <- disturbance_raster_km2 / soft_bottom_aligned
# We are doing this because we don't believe that trawling is random. We believe that trawls primarily target soft bottom and want to correct for that
```

```{r}
# One trawl = 5 years of impact → annual disturbance scaled by 1/5 (0.2).
disturbance_km_per_km_rodalith <- disturbance_km_per_km_soft_bottom / 0.2

# Cap at 1
disturbance_km_per_km_rodalith[disturbance_km_per_km_rodalith > 1] <- 1
summary(values(disturbance_km_per_km_rodalith[[7]]))
```

## MAKE SURE VALUES ARE BETWEEB 0-1
```{r}
# Find how many km² of soft‑bottom disturbed per km² of soft‑bottom
weighted_pressure <- disturbance_km_per_km_rodalith * soft_bottom_aligned
summary(values(weighted_pressure[[7]]))
```








```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(weighted_pressure[[7]]) +
  tm_raster(
    palette = "-viridis",
    title = "km² of rodalith disturbed per km² of radalith present (Year 7)",
    alpha = 0.9,
    style = "cont"
  ) +
tm_shape(ohi_regions_marine) +
  tm_borders(col = "white", lwd = 2) +
tm_layout(
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    frame = FALSE
)
```




```{r}
# Load region raster template (1 km resolution)
template <- rast(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "ohi_marine_raster_1km.tif"))

# 1. Align disturbance-over-rodoliths stack to template grid
disturbance_aligned <- project(weighted_pressure, template)

# 2. Extract region IDs (one per pixel)
region_ids <- as.vector(values(template))

# 3. Number of pixels
n_cells <- ncell(template)

# 4. Number of years in the disturbance stack
n_years <- nlyr(disturbance_aligned)

# 5. Build long-format dataframe: pixel × year
df_raster_regions <- tibble(
  region_id   = rep(region_ids, times = n_years),
  year        = rep(years, each = n_cells),
  disturbance = as.vector(values(disturbance_aligned)),
  rodolith_area = rep(as.vector(values(soft_bottom_aligned)), times = n_years)
)

# 6. Clean out NA rows
df_raster_regions <- df_raster_regions |>
  filter(!is.na(region_id),
         !is.na(disturbance),
         !is.na(rodolith_area))


rodolith_pressure_df <- df_raster_regions |>
  group_by(region_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    Pressure  = mean(disturbance, na.rm = TRUE),
    RHO_score = 1 - Pressure,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rodolith_pressure_df
```

## Current rho
```{r}
# Pick the year you want to display
year_to_show <- 2025   # <-- change this to any year

# Filter for that year
rodolith_year <- rodolith_pressure_df |>
  filter(year == year_to_show) |>
  arrange(region_id)

# Styled kable table
rodolith_year |>
  select(region_id, Pressure, RHO_score) |>
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Region ID", "Pressure", "RHO_score"),
    align = c("c", "r", "r")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    setNames(
      3,
      paste0("Current Status (RHO) Scores — Year ", year_to_show)
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# Pick the year you want to map
year_to_show <- 2025   # <-- change this to any year

# Filter your multi-year DF for that year
rodolith_year <- rodolith_pressure_df |>
  filter(year == year_to_show) |>
  mutate(region_id = as.integer(region_id))

# Prepare OHI regions with numeric region_id
ohi_regions_marine <- ohi_regions_marine |>
  mutate(rgn_id_num = as.integer(gsub("Region_", "", rgn_id)))

# Join the selected year's scores onto the polygons
ohi_regions_map_rodolith <- ohi_regions_marine |>
  left_join(
    rodolith_year |> select(region_id, RHO_score),
    by = c("rgn_id_num" = "region_id")
  )

# Plot
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(ohi_regions_map_rodolith) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "RHO_score",
    palette = "-viridis",
    title = paste0("Rodolith RHO_score (Year ", year_to_show, ")"),
    alpha = 0.9,
    border.col = "white",
    border.lwd = 1
  ) +
tm_layout(
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    frame = FALSE
)

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Define region colors
rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

# Clean region names in rodolith_pressure_df to match color names
rodolith_pressure_df <- rodolith_pressure_df |>
  mutate(
    region_clean = paste0("Region_", region_id),   # numeric → Region_#
    region_clean = gsub("_", " ", region_clean)    # Region_1 → Region 1
  )

# Clean color names to match cleaned labels ("Region 1", etc.)
rgn_colors_clean <- setNames(
  rgn_colors,
  gsub("_", " ", names(rgn_colors))                # Region_1 → Region 1
)

# RHO time series plot with custom colors
ggplot(
  rodolith_pressure_df,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = RHO_score,
    group = region_clean,
    color = region_clean
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rgn_colors_clean) +
  labs(
    title = "RHO Score Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "RHO Score",
    color = "Region ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
rho_condition_df <- rodolith_pressure_df |>
  filter(year %in% c(2007, 2025)) |>                     # baseline + current year
  select(region_id, year, RHO_score) |>                  # keep needed columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = RHO_score
  ) |>                                                   # wide format: columns 2007 and 2025
  mutate(
    condition_score = (`2025` / `2007`) * 100,           # compute condition score
    condition_score = pmin(condition_score, 100)         # cap at 100
  )

rho_condition_df
```

```{r}
rho_trend_df <- rodolith_pressure_df |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2025)) |>                     # baseline + current year
  select(region_id, year, RHO_score) |>                  # keep needed columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = RHO_score
  ) |>                                                   # wide format: columns 2015 and 2025
  mutate(
    trend = ((`2025` / `2015`)^(1/10) - 1) * 100,        # 10-year annualized % change
    year  = 2025                                         # set trend year
  ) |>
  select(region_id, year, trend)

rho_trend_df
```

## km² of disturbance OVER rodolith beds

```{r}
disturbance_raster_km2_uncapped <- fishing_rasters * 3.704 * 0.030
rodolith_presence_1km <- rodolith_beds_1km > 0

# 2. Align rodolith presence raster to the fishing grid (nearest neighbor)
rodolith_presence_aligned <- project(
  rodolith_presence_1km,
  disturbance_raster_km2_uncapped[[1]],
  method = "near"
)

# 3. Mask disturbance raster so ONLY rodolith cells remain
disturbance_over_rodoliths <- mask(
  disturbance_raster_km2_uncapped,
  rodolith_presence_aligned,
  maskvalues = 0
)
```

```{r}
summary(values(disturbance_over_rodoliths[[1]]))
max(disturbance_over_rodoliths[[1]])
```
```{r}
disturbance_over_rodoliths_aligned <- project(disturbance_over_rodoliths, template)

df_disturbance_rodolith <- tibble(
  region_id = as.vector(values(template)),
  disturbance = as.vector(values(disturbance_over_rodoliths_aligned[[7]]))
) |>
  filter(!is.na(region_id), !is.na(disturbance)) |>
  group_by(region_id) |>
  summarise(
    disturbance_over_rodoliths = mean(disturbance)
  )
df_disturbance_rodolith
```


```{r}
# disturbance_aligned: SpatRaster with 19 layers (2007–2025)
# soft_bottom_aligned: rodolith area raster (1 layer)

# Compute pixel-level Pressure for each year
pressure_rasters <- disturbance_aligned / soft_bottom_aligned

# Convert Pressure to RHO (Condition)
rho_rasters <- 1 - pressure_rasters

# Optional: cap values between 0–1
rho_rasters[rho_rasters < 0] <- 0
rho_rasters[rho_rasters > 1] <- 1

# Name layers by year
names(rho_rasters) <- paste0("RHO_", years)

rho_rasters

```

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(rho_rasters[[which(years == 2025)]]) +
  tm_raster(
    palette = "-viridis",
    title = "RHO Score (2025)",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
tm_shape(ohi_regions_marine) +
  tm_borders(col = "white", lwd = 2)

```
